## LIBRARIES

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(here)
```


## AGGREGATE STECF DATA --------------------------------------------------

```{r}
### Importing landings data------------------------------------------------
STECF_lgs_2002_2010 <- read.csv(here("data/fisheries_data/STECF_2011_landings_2002_2010.csv"), header = TRUE, sep = ',') %>% 
  mutate(value = gsub(" ", "", value),
         value = as.numeric(value)) #value was character
  
STECF_lgs_2008_2014 <- read.csv(here("data/fisheries_data/STECF_2015_landings_2008_2014.csv"), header = TRUE, sep = ',')

STECF_lgs_2013_2022 <- read.csv(here("data/fisheries_data/STECF_2023_landings_2013_2022.csv"), header = TRUE, sep = ',') %>% 
  mutate(year_publication = 2023)
#first year is the file publication and other years represent the period recorded in the file

summary(STECF_lgs_2002_2010)
summary(STECF_lgs_2008_2014)
summary(STECF_lgs_2013_2022)

### Selection of species that are in Osmose & commercial-----------------
# Vector of Osmose commercial species
species_OSMOSE_MED <- read.csv(here("data/fisheries_data/species_OSMOSE_MED.csv"), header = TRUE, sep = ',') %>% 
  
  rename(scientific_name = species_name)


species_code_F <- read.csv(here("data/fisheries_data/cl_fi_species_groups.csv"), header = TRUE, sep = ',') %>% 
  
  rename(species_code = X3A_Code) %>% 
  
  mutate(scientific_name = gsub(" ", "", Scientific_Name)) %>% 
  
  select(species_code, scientific_name) %>% 
  
  mutate(scientific_name = case_when(scientific_name == "Auxisrochei" ~ "Auxisrocheirochei",
                                  
                                  scientific_name == "Chelonauratus" ~ "Lizaaurata",
                                  
                                  scientific_name == "Mullusbarbatus" ~ "Mullusbarbatusbarbatus",
                                  
                                  scientific_name == "Platichthysflesus" ~ "Platichthysflesusflesus",
                                  
                                  TRUE ~ scientific_name)) %>% 
  
  distinct()

  
species_osmose_commercial <- left_join(species_OSMOSE_MED, species_code_F, by = "scientific_name") %>% 
  
  filter(F > 0 & ! scientific_name %in% c("Alosaalosa", "Alosafallax", "Anguillaanguilla")) 

table(is.na(species_osmose_commercial))

list_species_code <- species_osmose_commercial$species_code
print(list_species_code)
length(list_species_code) #84 species


# Selecting landings data
STECF_lgs_2002_2010_sorted <- subset(STECF_lgs_2002_2010, species_code %in% list_species_code)
STECF_lgs_2008_2014_sorted <- subset(STECF_lgs_2008_2014, species_code %in% list_species_code)
STECF_lgs_2013_2022_sorted <- subset(STECF_lgs_2013_2022, species_code %in% list_species_code)

# Deleting NA and 0 and catch data that are only in weight or in value 
# NA
table(is.na(STECF_lgs_2002_2010_sorted$value)) # no NA
table(is.na(STECF_lgs_2008_2014_sorted$value)) # no NA
table(is.na(STECF_lgs_2013_2022_sorted$totwghtlandg)) # no NA
table(is.na(STECF_lgs_2013_2022_sorted$totvallandg)) # no NA

# Zero
table(STECF_lgs_2002_2010_sorted$value == 0)
table(STECF_lgs_2008_2014_sorted$value == 0)
table(STECF_lgs_2013_2022_sorted$totwghtlandg == 0)
table(STECF_lgs_2013_2022_sorted$totvallandg == 0)

STECF_lgs_2002_2010_sorted <- STECF_lgs_2002_2010_sorted %>% 
  filter(value > 0)

STECF_lgs_2008_2014_sorted <- STECF_lgs_2008_2014_sorted %>% 
  filter(value > 0)

STECF_lgs_2013_2022_sorted <- STECF_lgs_2013_2022_sorted %>% 
  filter(totwghtlandg > 0 & totvallandg > 0)

### Transforming value colums into totwghtlandg & totvallandg
STECF_lgs_2002_2010_sorted <- STECF_lgs_2002_2010_sorted %>% 
  group_by(across(-c(value))) %>% 
  summarise(value = sum(value)) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from = variable_code, values_from = value) %>% 
  filter(! (is.na(totwghtlandg) | is.na(totvallandg))) %>% #some values exist only in weight or in value €
  mutate(year_publication = 2011)


STECF_lgs_2008_2014_sorted <- STECF_lgs_2008_2014_sorted %>% 
  select(-c(comments, fs_name, cluster_name, unit, variable_name)) %>% 
  group_by(across(-c(value))) %>% 
  summarise(value = sum(value)) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  filter(value != 0) %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from = variable_code, values_from = value) %>% 
  filter(! (is.na(totwghtlandg) | is.na(totvallandg))) %>% #some values exist only in weight or in value €
  mutate(year_publication = 2015)


### Joining all tabs together
# Clearing STECF_lgs_2013_2022_sorted
colnames(STECF_lgs_2013_2022_sorted)

intersect_1 <- intersect(colnames(STECF_lgs_2002_2010_sorted),
                         colnames(STECF_lgs_2008_2014_sorted))
intersect_all <- intersect(intersect_1, 
                           colnames(STECF_lgs_2013_2022_sorted))

STECF_data_joined <- full_join(STECF_lgs_2002_2010_sorted,
                        STECF_lgs_2008_2014_sorted, 
                        by = intersect_1) %>% 
  full_join(STECF_lgs_2013_2022_sorted, by = intersect_all) %>% 
  select(all_of(intersect_all))

table(is.na(STECF_data_joined))


##### outlier detection 
colnames(STECF_data_joined)


outlier_detection = STECF_data_joined %>%
  mutate(price = totvallandg/(totwghtlandg)) %>%
  filter(price < 50) %>%
  group_by(species_code) %>%
  mutate(q5 = quantile(price , 0.05),
         q95 = quantile(price , 0.95)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  filter(price < q95) %>%
  filter(price > q5) %>%
  group_by(species_code) %>%
  mutate(median = quantile(price, 0.5),
         mean = mean(price, na.rm = T)) 

STECF_data_joined = STECF_data_joined %>%
  mutate(price = totvallandg/(totwghtlandg)) %>%
  filter(price < 50) %>%
  group_by(species_code) %>%
  mutate(q5 = quantile(price , 0.05),
         q95 = quantile(price , 0.95)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  filter(price < q95) %>%
  filter(price > q5)

## Transformation variables datasets ------------------------------------------------
### Country names
STECF_data_1 <- STECF_data_joined %>% 
  mutate(fishing_entity = case_when(country_code == "CYP" ~ "Cyprus",
                                  country_code == "ESP" ~ "Spain",
                                  country_code == "FRA" ~ "France",
                                  country_code == "GBR" ~ "Great Britain",
                                  country_code == "GRC" ~ "Greece",
                                  country_code == "HRV" ~ "Croatia",
                                  country_code == "ITA" ~ "Italy",
                                  country_code == "MLT" ~ "Malta",
                                  country_code == "SVN" ~ "Slovenia"))

table(is.na(STECF_data_1$fishing_entity))


### Species name 
STECF_data_2 <- left_join(STECF_data_1, species_osmose_commercial, by = c('species_code'), relationship = "many-to-many")

table(is.na(STECF_data_2))


### Gear types
sort(unique(STECF_data_2$fishing_tech))
sort(unique(STECF_data_2$vessel_length))
artisanal_vessels <- c("VL0006", "VL0010", "VL0012", "VL0612", "VL1012")

STECF_data_3 <- STECF_data_2 %>% 
  mutate(fleet_v4 = case_when(vessel_length %in% artisanal_vessels
                                       ~ "Artisanal",
                              
                              fishing_tech == "DFN" & ! vessel_length %in% artisanal_vessels
                                       ~ "Other_industrial_fleets_and_unknown",
                                       
                              fishing_tech == "DRB" & ! vessel_length %in% artisanal_vessels
                                       ~ "Other_industrial_fleets_and_unknown",
                                       
                              fishing_tech == "DTS" & ! vessel_length %in% artisanal_vessels
                                       ~ "Bottom_trawlers",
                              
                              fishing_tech == "FPO" & ! vessel_length %in% artisanal_vessels
                                       ~ "Artisanal",
                              
                              fishing_tech == "HOK" & ! vessel_length %in% artisanal_vessels
                                       ~ "Longliners",
                              
                              fishing_tech == "MGO" & ! scientific_name %in% c("Thunnusthynnus", "Thunnusalalunga") & ! vessel_length %in% artisanal_vessels
                                       ~ "Other_industrial_fleets_and_unknown",
                              
                              fishing_tech == "MGP" & ! scientific_name %in% c("Thunnusthynnus", "Thunnusalalunga") & ! vessel_length %in% artisanal_vessels
                                       ~ "Other_industrial_fleets_and_unknown",
                              
                              fishing_tech == "PG" & ! vessel_length %in% artisanal_vessels
                                       ~ "Other_industrial_fleets_and_unknown",
                              
                              fishing_tech == "PGO" & ! vessel_length %in% artisanal_vessels
                                       ~ "Other_industrial_fleets_and_unknown",
                              
                              fishing_tech == "PGP" & ! vessel_length %in% artisanal_vessels
                                       ~ "Other_industrial_fleets_and_unknown",
                              
                              fishing_tech == "PMP" & ! vessel_length %in% artisanal_vessels
                                       ~ "Other_industrial_fleets_and_unknown",
                              
                              fishing_tech %in% c("MGO", "MGP") & scientific_name %in% c("Thunnusthynnus", "Thunnusalalunga") & ! vessel_length %in% artisanal_vessels
                                       ~ "Tuna_purse_seiners",
                              
                              fishing_tech %in% c("PS", "PTS", "TM") & ! scientific_name %in% c("Thunnusthynnus", "Thunnusalalunga") & ! vessel_length %in% artisanal_vessels
                                       ~ "Purse_seiners_and_pelagic_trawlers",
                              
                              fishing_tech %in% c("PS", "PTS", "TM") & scientific_name %in% c("Thunnusthynnus", "Thunnusalalunga") & ! vessel_length %in% artisanal_vessels
                                       ~ "Tuna_purse_seiners",
                              
                              
                              fishing_tech == "TBB" & ! vessel_length %in% artisanal_vessels
                                       ~ "Bottom_trawlers",
                             
                              TRUE ~ fishing_tech))  

table(is.na(STECF_data_3))


# Last modification and summarising
STECF_data_4 <- STECF_data_3 %>%
  
  mutate(area_type = "sub_reg") %>%
  
  rename(species_name = scientific_name,
         landed_value = totvallandg,
         tonnes = totwghtlandg,
         area_name = sub_reg) %>%
  
  filter(tonnes != 0 & landed_value != 0) %>%
  
  # STECF data is in kilos
    mutate(tonnes = tonnes) %>% 

  #mutate(tonnes = tonnes / 1000) %>% 
  
  select(-c("species_id", "F")) %>% 
  
  group_by(across(-c(tonnes, landed_value, fishing_tech, vessel_length))) %>% 
  # summarising at the fleet scale not the fishing_tech since I never look at that detail again
  
  summarise(tonnes = sum(tonnes),
            landed_value = sum(landed_value))
  
table(is.na(STECF_data_4))

test = STECF_data_4 %>%
  mutate(price = landed_value/tonnes)
### Year overlap in data: 2008-2010 & 2013-2014--------------------------

# 1st overlap: from 2008 to 2010-----------------------------------------
STECF_2008_2010 <- subset(STECF_data_4, year %in% c(2008, 2009, 2010))
table(STECF_2008_2010$year_publication)

# Aggregating the dataset: summarising the catch value for each key
  # Identification key
colnames(STECF_2008_2010)

STECF_2008_2010_key <- STECF_2008_2010 %>% 
  unite("key_1", -tonnes, -landed_value, -year_publication, sep = "_", remove = FALSE) 

STECF_2008_2010_aggregated <- STECF_2008_2010_key %>% 
  group_by(key_1, year_publication) %>% 
  summarise(tonnes = sum(tonnes),
            landed_value = sum(landed_value))

# Comparing the keys between the two files, 2011 and 2015
STECF_2011 <- STECF_2008_2010_aggregated %>% filter(year_publication == 2011)
STECF_2015 <- STECF_2008_2010_aggregated %>% filter(year_publication == 2015)

# Identifying common keys
common_keys <- intersect(STECF_2011$key_1, STECF_2015$key_1)

# Extracting unique data
corresponding_data_1 <- STECF_2008_2010_key %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  select(-year_publication)

unique_data_2008_2010 <- STECF_2008_2010_aggregated %>% 
  select(-year_publication) %>% 
  filter(!key_1 %in% common_keys) %>% 
  left_join(corresponding_data_1, by = c("key_1", "tonnes", "landed_value"))

length(unique(unique_data_2008_2010$key_1)) == length(unique_data_2008_2010$key_1)

# Averaging common data
corresponding_data_2 <- STECF_2008_2010_key %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  select(-c(year_publication, tonnes, landed_value)) %>% 
  distinct(key_1, .keep_all = TRUE)

# summarising will erase the corresponding data in other colums
# removing tonnes and landed because they won't match with the averages unless the data was identical in 2011 and 2015 files

common_data_2008_2010 <- STECF_2008_2010_aggregated %>% 
  select(-year_publication) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  filter(key_1 %in% common_keys) %>% 
  group_by(key_1) %>% 
  summarise(landed_value = mean(landed_value),
            tonnes = mean(tonnes),
            .groups = 'drop') %>% 
  left_join(corresponding_data_2, by = c("key_1"))

any(duplicated(corresponding_data_2$key_1)) # FALSE
table(is.na(corresponding_data_2$key_1)) # FALSE

length(unique(common_data_2008_2010$key_1)) == length(common_keys) # TRUE

# Final step: removing data in STECF_data_4 for 2008, 2009, 2010 and join both datasets (unique data and common data)

cols_join_1 <- intersect(colnames(STECF_data_4), colnames(unique_data_2008_2010))

cols_join_2 <- c(cols_join_1, "key_1")

STECF_data_5 <- STECF_data_4 %>% 
  filter(!year %in% c(2008, 2009, 2010)) %>% 
  full_join(unique_data_2008_2010, by = cols_join_1) %>% 
  full_join(common_data_2008_2010, by = cols_join_2) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  select(-key_1)

table(STECF_data_5$year)
table(is.na(STECF_data_5$year_publication))


# 2nd overlap: from 2013 to 2014-----------------------------------------
STECF_2013_2014 <- subset(STECF_data_4, year %in% c(2013, 2014))
table(STECF_2013_2014$year_publication)

# Aggregating the dataset: summarising the catch value for each key
  # Identification key
colnames(STECF_2013_2014)

STECF_2013_2014_key <- STECF_2013_2014 %>% 
  unite("key_1", -tonnes, -landed_value, -year_publication, sep = "_", remove = FALSE) 

STECF_2013_2014_aggregated <- STECF_2013_2014_key %>% 
  group_by(key_1, year_publication) %>% 
  summarise(tonnes = sum(tonnes),
            landed_value = sum(landed_value))

# Comparing the keys between the two files, 2015 and 2022
STECF_2015 <- STECF_2013_2014_aggregated %>% filter(year_publication == 2015)
STECF_2023 <- STECF_2013_2014_aggregated %>% filter(year_publication == 2023)

# Identifying common keys
common_keys <- intersect(STECF_2015$key_1, STECF_2023$key_1)
## /!\ there is no common key therefore all data can be kept
```

```{r}
EEZ <- list(Albania, Algeria, Croatia, Cyprus_North, Cyprus_South,

                'Greece', 'Italy', 'Lebanon', 'Libya', 'Malta', 'Syria', 'Tunisia',
                'Turkey', 'Montenegro', 'Corsica', 'Crete', 'Sicily', 'Sardinia',
                'Balearic', 'France', 'Egypt', 'Israel', 'Morocco', 'Spain')

### Aggregating data -----------------------------------------------------
col <- names(Albania) # joining keys

SAU_1950_2019 <- full_join(EEZ[[1]], EEZ[[2]], by = col)

for (i in 3:24){
  
  SAU_1950_2019 <- SAU_1950_2019 %>% full_join(EEZ[[i]], by = col)
  
}

# to check that all the lines were kept
s = c()
for (i in 1:24){
  
  s = c(s, nrow(EEZ[[i]])) 
}
print(sum(s) == nrow(SAU_1950_2019)) #TRUE


### Filtering data and renaming species----------------------------------
# Deleting NA and 0 and catch data that are only in weight or in value 
table(is.na(SAU_1950_2019$landed_value))
table(is.na(SAU_1950_2019$tonnes))
table(SAU_1950_2019$landed_value == 0)
table(SAU_1950_2019$tonnes == 0)

# Nas in landed_value + Nas in uncertainty_score = number of Nas in dataset

SAU_1950_2019_sorted <- SAU_1950_2019 %>% 
  
  select(-uncertainty_score) %>% 
  
  filter(! is.na(landed_value) & ! is.na(tonnes) 
         & landed_value > 0 & tonnes > 0)

table(is.na(SAU_1950_2019_sorted$landed_value))
table(is.na(SAU_1950_2019_sorted$tonnes))
table(SAU_1950_2019_sorted$landed_value == 0)
table(SAU_1950_2019_sorted$tonnes == 0)
table(is.na(SAU_1950_2019_sorted)) # FALSE

SAU_1950_2019_sorted$present_OSMOSE <- NA

# Complete dataset by correcting names (when changed) and by reassigning genus at the species level according to SAU/FAO proportions
SAU_2002_2019 <- SAU_1950_2019_sorted %>% 
  
  filter(fishing_sector %in% c('Industrial', 'Artisanal') & year > 2001) %>% 
  
  mutate(scientific_name = case_when(scientific_name == 'Etrumeus sadina' ~ 'Etrumeus teres',
                                     scientific_name == 'Chelon auratus' ~ 'Liza aurata',
                                     scientific_name == 'Gobius ophiocephalus' ~ 'Zosterisessor ophiocephalus', 
                                     scientific_name == 'Psetta maxima' ~ 'Scophthalmus maximus', 
                                     TRUE ~ scientific_name)) %>% 
  
  mutate(scientific_name_corrected = scientific_name) %>%
  
  # CEPHALOPODS -----------------------------------------------------------

# Loligo vulgaris
mutate(scientific_name_corrected = case_when(scientific_name %in% c("Loligo", "Loliginidae") ~ "Loligo vulgaris",
                                             TRUE ~ scientific_name_corrected)) %>%

outlier_detection = SAU_data_4 %>%
  mutate(price = landed_value/(tonnes * 1000)) %>%
  filter(price < 50) %>%
  group_by(species_name) %>%
  mutate(q5 = quantile(price , 0.05),
         q95 = quantile(price , 0.95)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  filter(price < q95) %>%
  filter(price > q5) %>%
  group_by(species_name) %>%
  mutate(median = quantile(price, 0.5),
         mean = mean(price, na.rm = T)) 

SAU_data_4 = SAU_data_4 %>%
  mutate(price = landed_value/(tonnes * 1000)) %>%
  filter(price < 50) %>%
  group_by(species_name) %>%
  mutate(q5 = quantile(price , 0.05),
         q95 = quantile(price , 0.95)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  filter(price < q95) %>%
  filter(price > q5) %>%
  dplyr::select(-price, -q5, -q95)

## Aggregating fleets----------------------------------------------------

SAU_data_5 <- SAU_data_4 %>% 
  # Fleets version 2
  mutate(grouped_gear_types = case_when(gear_type %in% c("pole and line",
                                                         "longline",
                                                         "hand lines") ~ "hooksandlines",

                                        gear_type %in% c("bottom trawl", "shrimp trawl") & group2 != "Crustacean" ~ "bottomtrawl",

                                        gear_type %in% c("bottom trawl", "shrimp trawl") & group2 == "Crustacean" ~ "shrimptrawl",

                                        gear_type %in% c("shrimp trawl") ~ "shrimptrawl",

                                        gear_type %in% c("pelagic trawl") ~ "purseseineandpelagictrawl",

                                        # gear_type %in% c("tuna purse seine") ~ "tuna purse seiners",

                                        gear_type %in% c("purse seine") & ! species_name %in% c("Thunnusthynnus", "Thunnusalalunga") ~ "purseseineandpelagictrawl", 
                                        
                                        gear_type %in% c("purse seine") & species_name %in% c("Thunnusthynnus", "Thunnusalalunga") ~ "tunapurseseine",
                                        
                                        gear_type %in% c("small scale encircling nets",
                                                         "small scale gillnets",
                                                         "small scale seine nets",
                                                         "small scale trammel net",
                                                         "small scale other nets",
                                                         "small scale purse seine",
                                                         "cast nets",
                                                         "bagnets") ~ "artisanalnets",

                                        gear_type %in% c("small scale lines",
                                                         "small scale longline",
                                                         "small scale hand lines") ~ "artisanallines",

                                        gear_type %in% c("artisanal fishing gear") & fishing_sector == "Industrial" ~ "artisanallines", # only for Xiphias gladius (hook for sure)

                                        gear_type %in% c("small scale pots or traps",
                                                         "hand or tools",
                                                         "harpoon",
                                                         "artisanal fishing gear",
                                                         "other", 
                                                         "unknown class", 
                                                         "unknown by author",
                                                         "unknown by source") & fishing_sector == "Artisanal" ~ "mixedartisanal",

                                        gear_type %in% c("dredge") ~ "dredge",

                                        gear_type %in% c("gillnet") ~ "gillnet",

                                        TRUE ~ "industrialothers")) %>% 
  
  rename(fleet = grouped_gear_types) %>% 
  
  # Fleets version 4
  
  mutate(fleet_v4 = case_when(fleet %in% c("artisanallines", "artisanalnets", "mixedartisanal") ~ "Artisanal",
                              
                              fleet %in% c("bottomtrawl", "shrimptrawl") ~ "Bottom_trawlers",
                              
                              fleet == "purseseineandpelagictrawl" ~ "Purse_seiners_and_pelagic_trawlers",
                              
                              fleet == "tunapurseseine" ~ "Tuna_purse_seiners",
                              
                              fleet == "hooksandlines" ~ "Longliners",
                              
                              fleet %in% c("dredge", "industrialothers", "gillnet") ~ "Other_industrial_fleets_and_unknown",
                              
                              TRUE ~ fleet))

table(SAU_data_5$fleet_v4)
```

# COMBINING BOTH TABS SAU AND STECF--------------------------------------

```{r}

SAU_data <- read.csv(here("data/fisheries_data/SAU_data_price.csv"))
STECF_data <- read.csv(here("data/fisheries_data/STECF_data.csv"))

groups <- read.csv(here("data/fisheries_data/classification_commercial_interest.csv"), header = TRUE, sep = ";") %>%
   select(species_name, group2, final_commercial_interest, species_id) %>%
   rename(commercial_interest = final_commercial_interest) %>% 
  
  mutate(species_name = case_when(species_name == "Diplodussargussargus" ~ "Diplodussargus", TRUE ~ species_name))

## Combining both tabs---------------------------------------------------
# Rearranging tab
SAU_data <- SAU_data %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(-c("group2", "species_id", "F"))


# Joining
combined_data <- full_join(SAU_data, STECF_data, by = intersect(colnames(SAU_data),colnames(STECF_data))) %>%
  
  left_join(groups, by = c("species_name")) %>%
  
  # transformation 1 row for 1 GSA
  separate_rows(gsa, sep = ",") %>%
  
  # making sure there is no space in the characters
  mutate(gsa = str_trim(gsa)) %>%
  
  # creating the id
  mutate(gsa = paste0("GSA ", gsa)) %>% 
  
  mutate(price = landed_value / (tonnes * 1000))
```

# FILTERING AND AVERAGING FINAL DATA-------------------------------------

```{r}
### First step: selecting years from 2006-2013 (Osmose model)

years_osmose <- c("2006", "2007", "2008", "2009", "2010", "2011", "2012", "2013")

data_all_years <- combined_data


### Extracting unique data (SAU or STECF) and common data----------------
data_osmose <- combined_data %>%
  
  filter(year %in% years_osmose) %>% 
  
  ungroup() %>% 
  
  select(year, fishing_entity, species_name, fleet_v4, gsa, tonnes, landed_value, source, group2, commercial_interest, species_id, price) %>%
  
  # Creating key
  unite("key", -tonnes, -landed_value, -price, -source, sep = "_", remove = FALSE) %>% 
  
  #summarising
  group_by(key, year, fishing_entity, species_name, fleet_v4, gsa, source, group2, commercial_interest, species_id) %>% 
  
  summarise(landed_value = sum(landed_value),
            tonnes = sum(tonnes),
            price = landed_value / (tonnes * 1000))

# SAU and STECF keys
keys_SAU <- data_osmose %>% 
  
  filter(source == "SAU") %>% 
  
  distinct(key) %>% 
  
  pull(key)


keys_STECF <- data_osmose %>% 
  
  filter(source == "STECF") %>% 
  
  distinct(key) %>% 
  
  pull(key)

# Common keys between SAU and STECF
common_keys_sau_stecf <- intersect(keys_SAU, keys_STECF)

# Extracting unique keys data from data_osmose
unique_data_sau_or_stecf <- data_osmose %>% 
  
  ungroup() %>% 
  
  filter(! key %in% common_keys_sau_stecf) %>% 
  
  select(-source)

# Extracting common keys in data_osmose and averaging
common_data_sau_stecf <- data_osmose %>% 
  
  ungroup() %>% 
  
  filter(key %in% common_keys_sau_stecf) %>% 
  
  group_by(across(all_of(setdiff(colnames(data_osmose), c("landed_value", "tonnes", "price", "source"))))) %>% 
  
  summarise(landed_value = mean(landed_value),
            tonnes = mean(landed_value),
            price = mean(price))
    
# table(is.na(common_data_sau_stecf)) # FALSE
# table(common_data_sau_stecf$landed_value == 0) # FALSE
# table(common_data_sau_stecf$tonnes == 0) # FALSE
# table(common_data_sau_stecf$price == 0) # FALSE

# Combining unique and common data---------------------------------------
Price_data <- full_join(unique_data_sau_or_stecf,
                        common_data_sau_stecf,
                        by = colnames(unique_data_sau_or_stecf)) %>% 
  
  select(-key)

# table(is.na(Price_data)) # FALSE
# table(Price_data$landed_value == 0) # FALSE
# table(Price_data$tonnes == 0) # FALSE
# table(Price_data$price == 0) # FALSE


# Saving tab-------------------------------------------------------------
write.csv(Price_data, file = "Price_data_updated_without_outliers.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```

# Classification species according to commercial importance
```{r}

Price_data_mean = Price_data %>%
  group_by(species_name) %>%
  summarize(landed_value = mean(landed_value)) %>%
    arrange(desc(landed_value)) %>%
  mutate(
    cum_value = cumsum(landed_value),
    cum_value_perc = cum_value / sum(landed_value)) %>%
   mutate(commercial_class = case_when(
      cum_value_perc <= 0.7 ~ "HC",
      cum_value_perc >= 0.9 ~ "LC",
      TRUE ~ "C"))
  
histogram <- ggplot(Price_data_mean, aes(x = landed_value, fill = commercial_class)) +
  geom_histogram() 
print(histogram)
ggsave(here("figures/commercial_classification/classification_commercial_interest_histogram.png"), dpi = 300, width = 6, height = 6)
```
